title: Equivalent notional and quote risk check

items.prompt: A bought-protection position is worth USD 357,482.24 at the liquid five-year quote of 160 basis points and USD 363,240.36 after the quote is bumped to 161 basis points with the flat hazard rate re-solved. Calculate the position's risky DV01 in USD per basis point.
items.explanation: The bump-and-reprice sensitivity is the value after the bump minus the value before it: 363,240.36 - 357,482.24 = USD 5,758.12 per basis point. It is positive because bought protection gains when the quote rises.

items.prompt: A trader has sold protection on a three-year contract. Valued for a protection buyer, the contract is worth USD -1,899,072.40 at the liquid quote and USD -1,893,025.81 after a one basis point bump with the hazard rate re-solved. Calculate the seller's risky DV01 in USD per basis point, using the sign convention that a positive number is a gain for the seller.
items.explanation: The seller's value is minus the buyer's value: USD 1,899,072.40 before and USD 1,893,025.81 after the bump. The seller's sensitivity is 1,893,025.81 - 1,899,072.40 = USD -6,046.59 per basis point; a seller loses when the quote rises.

items.prompt: A bought-protection position has risky DV01 of USD 5,758.117764 per basis point. One unit of notional of bought protection in the liquid five-year contract has risky DV01 of 0.000434070474 per basis point. Calculate the magnitude in USD of the liquid-tenor equivalent notional that offsets the position.
items.explanation: N_eq = -5,758.117764 / 0.000434070474 = -USD 13,265,398.4. The negative sign means the hedge sells protection in the five-year contract; its magnitude is USD 13,265,398.4.

items.prompt: A sold-protection position with notional USD 20,000,000 has risky DV01 of USD -6,046.591823 per basis point for the seller. One unit of notional of bought protection in the liquid five-year contract has risky DV01 of 0.000434070474 per basis point. Calculate the equivalent ratio of the liquid-tenor hedge to the position notional.
items.explanation: N_eq = -(-6,046.591823) / 0.000434070474 = +USD 13,929,977.2, so the hedge buys protection in the five-year contract. The equivalent ratio is 13,929,977.2 / 20,000,000 = 0.6965.
